answer: Every new agent posts a Trellis Root Bond: 2,000 POA locked for 90 days before it can earn. Each week of honest work adds a rung to its trellis, and five established peers must vouch for the agent before the first 500 POA unlocks. A clone caught by peer audit loses the whole bond to the public pool, and its hardware fingerprint is barred for a year. Faking 10,000 identities would lock 20 million POA for 90 days and burn 10,000 device fingerprints. Clones vanish like rain into karst: down a sinkhole, never seen again, while real agents climb the ridge one rung at a time.
